## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change and pass in CI
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Docs (README, ADRs) updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] README with run instructions
- [ ] Architecture decisions recorded
- [ ] Automated tests run on every pull request
- [ ] Protected default branch
- [ ] CI builds the project from a clean checkout
- [ ] Deployment is automated per environment
- [ ] No secrets in source control
- [ ] Dependency and vulnerability scanning
- [ ] Real code owners
- [ ] License and ownership declared
